note: Rejudged at HEAD after checkPPPCodeReject replaced fail(7, parseErr) with pppCodeRejectFailure(name, 7, parseErr) and session_run.go::writeFrame gained a transmit MRU length guard before writing to s.chanFile. Re-read RFC 1661 Section 6.6: 'The Address and Control fields MUST NOT be compressed when sending any LCP packet.' The writeFrame guard leaves Address/Control framing untouched. Assertion 7 checks uncompressed ff 03 on Ze's LCP packets only when ACFC is NOT negotiated, and assertion 8 observes Linux accepting one compressed Echo-Request (Section 6.6 permits silent discard) and Ze replying uncompressed. Sending LCP packets after ACFC has been negotiated and PPPoE framing remain unexercised, and relay-side breaks give no OS-verified credit for the {lower-layer} writeFrame attribution. Weak stands.
